messages:
sam: FYI planning a rolling maintenance for NZ edge GPU pool (apac-south-1) next Tue 01:30-03:30 UTC. Work: NIC driver + BIOS microcode + controlled BMC resets. Expect ~3 nodes offline per cohort (~9 GPUs). We'll do 3 cohorts across racks with a canary first.

lee: Can you confirm whether Dedicated tenants in that pool are scheduled? We need to avoid moving their traffic automatically.

sam: Good catch. Dedicated tenants are listed in OPS-5199. We'll mark their instances as 'no-evac' and coordinate manual migration with AMs.

tara: Suggest a thin-preheat: seed top-100 KV keys in apac-east 40m before, and spin up an extra small batch of nodes in apac-east to absorb cold misses. That avoids sudden p95 spikes.

sam: Agreed. Plan: preheat + autoscale apac-east by +2 machines for 60m. Also will temporarily lower router batch_size to 1.5x (experimental) for 10m post-cohort.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5199. Customer notices scheduled 48h and 2h before.

lee: Runbook + rollback criteria please. If NIC update causes increased packet drops we need a quick path.

sre_oncall: Oncall will own runbook. Runbook link: `docs/runbooks/apac-south-bios-nic-roll.md`. Rollback triggers: RX drops >2% for 3 consecutive minutes OR tail-latency p99 > 250ms for >3m -> start rollback. Escalation path in runbook. I'll be on the pager.

sam: Canary node will be nz-rack-3/node-02. Canary checklist: 1) NVMe and GPU temps stable for 5m, 2) host-level errors none in dmesg, 3) egress health OK (curl to health endpoint), 4) model-serving throughput within 10% of baseline.

tara: Command snippets for ops:``` 
# drain
kubectl cordon node/nz-03-02
kubectl drain node/nz-03-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180
# apply BIOS + NIC patch (runbook handles binary upload)
ssh root@nz-03-02 'systemctl stop redwood-inference && /opt/infra/bin/apply-bios && reboot'
```

sam: Note: ops should not power-cycle; only soft-reboot via BMC if instructed. If BMC remote fails we'll escalate to hardware ops.

infra-bot: Cohorts: cohort-A (rack-1 nodes 01-03), cohort-B (rack-2 nodes 01-03), cohort-C (rack-3 nodes 01-03). Canary: rack-3/node-02.

lee: Also, we'll enable short-circuit fallback to small-model variant for 20m when a cohort goes down (config: route.policy.model_fallback=true). That prevents client-facing latency regressions.

sam: I'll add the model_fallback toggle and a post-cohort throttle: reduce concurrent_infers by 25% for 10m.

tara: Cost note: expected cross-region burst egress + reserved-instance spin-up ~USD 180 for the window. Ops finance notified.

sre_oncall: Final ask: team in VC for the window? I can be remote but would like someone in-call for first cohort.

sam: I'll be on-call and in the VC for cohort-A. Posting support blurb to #support in 48h. Canary smoke checklist added to ticket.

infra-bot: Reminders scheduled: 48h -> #support, 2h -> #ops, 15m -> oncall. :bell:
